findings.statement: The recovered PR-289 implementation preserves strong generic byte, path, inode, content-address, authorization, mutation, and receipt controls, but admission is under-typed: one lane-wide evidence mapping is copied onto every generic component record, so complete native Planck, CF4, HSC, and KiDS roles and inter-record relationships are neither represented nor replay-validated. The smallest repair is an in-place extension of LaneSpec, DataIdentityRecordV2, the existing registry/evidence exact mappings, and evaluate_lane_identity; a parallel admission API is unnecessary.

claim_results.summary: Targeted mapping confirms that the current admission API is the correct reusable shell but cannot yet prove complete lane-native identity. The concrete in-place schema/factory/test extension below closes that specific gap while preserving zero-execution and NOT_AUTHORIZED semantics.

registry: Add ordered native_record_specs and native_relationship_specs to LaneSpec and each lane row; parse them in lane_registry_from_mapping with exact-key, uniqueness, endpoint, acyclicity/allowed-cycle, and component-coverage checks.

Keep required_component_ids/component_cardinality as the physical-byte inventory authority, but require a one-to-one native record spec for every affected-lane component and reject untyped extra records.
Leave public evaluator signatures and the ACT/DESI/JWST_SN component semantics intact.
evidence_and_records: Add ordered native_records and native_relationships to the exact evidence mapping. Each native record must bind record key, lane, survey/profile owner, typed native role, component_id, required semantic identity fields, and a content-derived native_record_id.

Extend DataIdentityRecordV2 with native_profile_id, native_record_id, native_role, survey_id, and relationship_ids; include all of them in _stable_payload so record_id changes on any semantic or relationship change.

Include the full canonical native profile in compute_source_locator_identity and lane_admission_bundle_id; otherwise semantic children can be swapped while component bytes/release/license remain unchanged.

Have _validate_evidence perform exact full-profile replay against LaneSpec before _build_record; verify ordered coverage, role-specific required fields, relationship endpoints/types, no cross-lane/survey substitution, and recomputed child/profile IDs.

invariants: SMICA and Commander are distinct records and form an explicit same-sky pair.
Both map records bind the same registered selection, pixelization, mask/window sky support, and the appropriate beam/operator roles.
FFP10/null is a typed record or an explicit registered unavailable status; a generic null_ensemble_id string is insufficient.
The admitted catalogue record explicitly depends on the exact row selection and full covariance.
Frame, sign, units, grouping, depth, and ZoA are typed roles linked to that exact catalogue/profile, not interchangeable lane-wide strings.
Every HSC child is owned by HSC and every KiDS child by KiDS; cross-survey substitution is rejected even when bytes and generic role names are otherwise valid.
PSF, n(z), calibration, response, and covariance are separate per survey.
Cross-covariance is a distinct typed relationship/record with both survey profile endpoints and cannot replace either within-survey covariance.

compatibility_risks: Changing exact registry/evidence keys intentionally rejects old generic fixtures; this is required fail-closed behavior but all positive helpers must migrate atomically.

Adding native payload to stable identities changes record_id, source_locator_identity, lane_admission_bundle_id, authorization_id, registry content_id, receipt_content_id, and the frozen generated receipt.

Expanding affected component sequences changes record counts and invalidates downstream record-ID-count fixtures in PR-290 through PR-292; those consumers must replay full canonical payloads instead of pinning counts alone.
The current _base_evidence and _mutation_descriptor generate placeholder lane-derived strings and will otherwise create false-positive complete admissions after parser changes.

Keeping universal lane-wide fields while adding native children risks contradictory duplicate authorities; validators must require equality where both are retained or migrate affected semantics exclusively to the typed child profile.
The runner's clean-root build still uses root_descriptors={}, so behavioral output remains zero-admission, but all bound source hashes and generated receipt bytes necessarily change.
patch_and_test_order: 1. Registry/spec first: declare affected-lane native record/relationship profiles and exact required roles; add native-profile mutation IDs while preserving claim/authorization ceilings.

2. Core registry types/parser: extend LaneSpec and lane_registry_from_mapping; add parser-only tests for duplicate roles, missing endpoints, unknown relationship types, cross-lane children, and incomplete coverage.

3. Evidence and stable identity: extend _EVIDENCE_FIELDS, compute_source_locator_identity, DataIdentityRecordV2, _build_record, and _validate_evidence; test recomputation and rejection of role/child/relationship tampering.

4. Admission chokepoint: make evaluate_lane_identity require complete canonical native replay before record construction and bind profile identity into lane_admission_bundle_id; add full positive Planck, CF4, HSC/KiDS fixtures plus a cross-lane negative matrix.

5. Mutation harness: migrate _mutation_descriptor and _probe_mutation to full typed Planck fixtures, add omissions/swaps/relationship-endpoint/survey-owner mutations, and retain all existing byte/path/inode/TOCTOU/authorization mutations.

6. Compatibility assertions: retain factory-only construction, root/time stability, no-root six-lane refusal, NOT_AUTHORIZED receipts, canonical refusal precedence, and ACT/DESI/JWST_SN regression behavior.

7. Runner/generated artifact last: focused tests, preflight, adjacent immutable PR-274 tests, receipt build/check, portable clean-archive replay; regenerate docs/generated/pr289_data_identity_v2_receipt.json and update PR delta only after executable semantics pass.
